messages:
emma (sales): quick heads-up — Orion Health POC just asked for a completed CAIQ + their custom security questionnaire. They want controls evidence (screenshots/configs) and SOC2 summary. Can someone own this and a target ETA? Link to their questionnaire: https://files.customer/orion/questionnaire.pdf

liam (security-engineer): I can pick this up. Clarifying: do they require BYOK or any special KMS attestation? Also any required formatting (PDF vs spreadsheet)?

emma (sales): BYOK = no for the POC. Spreadsheet preferred for the custom Qs so we can insert links to evidence. They want material by EOD Friday if possible (deploy next Tue).

clare (solutions-engineer): I can collect infra screenshots (KMS page, network ACLs, VPC peering) — will need read-only access to their POC workspace to grab exact values.

liam (security-engineer): Plan: 1) Export CAIQ baseline (we have a template) 2) Map CAIQ answers to their custom Q sheet 3) Collect evidence: SOC2 summary, KMS config, network diagram, sample incident response ticket 4) Upload bundle to shared drive and provide read-only links. Estimated effort: ~3 hours.

liam (security-engineer): @ops-bot can you open a read-only access request to the POC workspace for @clare and attach the access ticket here? Need this to capture screenshots.

ops-bot: Access request submitted (REQ-4572). ETA ~2.5 hours. Approvers: infra-admins.

jordan (sales-engineer): Customer said they'll also attach a partially filled questionnaire in ~30 mins. If we pre-populate answers that'd speed sign-off.

liam (security-engineer): Good. I'll pre-fill everything we have and mark any items that need customer confirmation. Deliverables: CAIQ export, filled spreadsheet, evidence bundle link. Target delivery: 2027-05-05 COB.

clare (solutions-engineer): FYI I'll capture screenshots at time-of-access and standardize filenames like orion_kms.png, orion_vpc.png to make linking easier.

liam (security-engineer): Uploaded draft evidence bundle: https://drive.redwood/Orion-POC-evidence (read-only). Filled answers: https://sheets.redwood/Orion-custom-q-draft. Notes column has outstanding items for customer to confirm.

emma (sales): Thanks team — I'll attach the drive links to the SFDC opportunity and send to the customer. Marking owner = liam. :thumbsup:

clare (solutions-engineer): Added infra screenshots to the drive and a short network diagram (redwood_network_orion.pdf).

liam (security-engineer): Updated status: ASSIGNED -> liam (security). Customer review pending. If they request BYOK or a deeper KMS attestation we'll re-open.

emma (sales): Customer ack'd receipt and will reply with two clarifications tomorrow. We'll leave this thread open until they confirm.

liam (security-engineer): Closing the task on our side for now — evidence uploaded and spreadsheet filled. Reopen if customer asks for additional artifacts. :white_check_mark:
